Cc: contracts@carterco.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay schedule & VAT evidence request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the onboarding call last week — we want to lock the invoicing cadence for the annual prepay (RWI-2026-AC-449) so our AP team can wire the funds and align bookkeeping. We need: 

- A clear drawdown schedule (dates + maximum unblock amounts) showing how Redwood will invoice against the committed spend.
- A sample invoice (so our finance team can confirm remit and PO expectations).
- VAT / tax evidence for Redwood’s EU routing (certificate, tax ID) — our European payroll needs this for reclaiming VAT.

Could you send a one-page operational playbook (internal owners + Slack/Email escalation path) and the invoice/drawdown artifacts by EOD Thursday?

Also, quick Q: will invoices be net-30 and is there a consolidated monthly statement for this committment?

Thanks,
Brianna Cole
Director, Billing Operations
FinServ Analytics

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Brianna Cole <billing@finserv.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay schedule & VAT evidence request

Hi Brianna — thanks for the clear list. I sketched an operational control framework that should meet FinServ’s AP needs and Redwood’s internal controls. Summary below; full attachments are included: annual_drawdown_schedule_RWI-AC-449.xlsx (drawdown lanes), invoice_sample_RWI-AC-449.pdf, vat_certificate_finserv_2025.pdf.

Operational highlights (summary):

1) Drawdown lanes & cadence
   - Monthly invoice windows tied to committed spend buckets.
   - Weekly optional micro-withdrawals (up to a pre-agreed cap) for burst usage; monthly reconciliation against committed spend.
   - Auto-sweep: any unused commit in a month will roll to next month (unless otherwise flagged).

2) Invoice & payment terms
   - Standard: Net 30 from invoice date.
   - Invoices: one PDF per drawdown (sample attached), with consolidated monthly statement on the 3rd business day of following month.

3) Controls & signoffs
   - Owner: Redwood Billing (Marcus Lin) — issues invoice and leads ledger reconciliation.
   - Finance liaison: Kimberly Park — dispute & credit approvals.
   - Escalation: regional finance manager + legal (cc’d) for contract or VAT exceptions.

4) VAT/tax routing
   - We are providing our EU VAT certificate and Redwood’s registration ID in the attached PDF. For EU reclaims, please share the specific local reclaim contact and we’ll provide ledger tagging for those invoices.

Next steps (proposed):
   - Marcus to confirm final ledger account numbers and remit routing (by Thu EOD).
   - Kimberly to confirm the consolidated statement format (sample included).
   - Brianna to confirm: 1) which bank account they will remit from, 2) whether AP needs W-9 / W-8 forms.

If that looks good we can produce a short amendment for signatures (DocuSign) to lock the cadence.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Finance Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: annual_drawdown_schedule_RWI-AC-449.xlsx; invoice_sample_RWI-AC-449.pdf; vat_certificate_finserv_2025.pdf

Thanks Jonas — tagging in owners and next actions.

Marcus: can you confirm the following by EOD Thursday so we can send the finalized playbook to FinServ?
- Ledger GLs that will appear on the invoice (two lines: committed prepay vs overage).
- Payment remit email and bank details to show on invoice PDF.
- Whether we will include the PO number field as mandatory or optional.

Neha: FinServ asked for EU VAT evidence; please validate the attached certificate and confirm whether we need country-specific tax IDs for each invoice line (some regions require extra identifiers).

I’ve attached a consolidated statement mock (invoice_sample_RWI-AC-449.pdf) and our suggested drawdown sheet. Edits welcome but we need to close by Thu so Brianna’s AP can schedule the wire.

On the statement format: I recommend the consolidated monthly statement plus individual drawdown PDFs for AP reconciliation. That keeps bank-level detail lean and lets them push a single monthly file into their ERP.

Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Jonas / Kimberly — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming a few items so we can route internally for the wire: 

- AP will pay from account: FinServ Analytics US Ops (ACH). We’ll share the bank info once we receive your invoice sample with remit details.
- Net 30 is fine. We will accept one consolidated monthly statement and individual drawdown PDFs for matching.
- For VAT: EU reclaim team requires the VAT certificate and the tax ID per invoice. Can Redwood include the tax ID on each invoice line as a suffix? If not, the line-level ledger tag will work but our reclaim tool needs the tax ID text on the PDF.

On legal / amendment: Carter & Co asked if the amendment can be limited-scope: invoicing cadence, drawdown caps, and the monthly consolidated statement — all other T&Cs remain in the master agreement. If you can route a short DocuSign amendment we’ll sign and then AP will schedule the wire.

Also: can you provide your W-9 (for our tax records) or W-8 as applicable?

Thanks — goal is to have the amendment signed and funds wired by the 21st of May.

Best,
Brianna Cole
Director, Billing Operations
FinServ Analytics
